root_idea.summary: The root centers on making something firm, sound, fitting, and established as true or right, in contrast to falsehood.
root_idea.development: From the idea of sound correspondence and secure establishment develop the meanings of truth and reality, what is due or obligatory, verification and validation, entitlement, and disputing a claim. Other branches extend to fittingness, central joining or sockets, and things that have reached a settled condition.

senses.definition: To become established as true, certain, or a realized fact; to prove true or come to pass.
senses.usage_conditions: Intransitive Form I usage, including expressions in which a saying, promise, judgment, or consequence becomes established or takes effect.

senses.definition: To become due, obligatory, incumbent, or justly deserved.
senses.usage_conditions: Often construed with عَلَى; may describe an obligation, a deserved consequence, or a judgment that becomes binding and takes effect. The passive حُقَّتْ is included under this sense.

senses.definition: To establish, validate, or make the truth prevail.
senses.usage_conditions: The Quranic construction إِحْقَاقُ الْحَقِّ includes establishing truth by manifesting its proofs and by completing and disseminating the revealed way.

senses.definition: To have, claim, or become entitled to a right or due; to deserve it.
senses.usage_conditions: Used of a lawful claim or title, including a right established against another person.

senses.definition: To incur or deserve a blameworthy consequence, especially sin or punishment.
senses.usage_conditions: In the Quranic construction concerning wrongdoing, the subject has done what makes the consequence deserved.

senses.definition: More entitled, deserving, worthy, or strongly possessed of a right or claim.
senses.usage_conditions: A comparative expression: it may denote an exclusive right or a right shared with another but stronger in degree.

senses.definition: Truer, more valid, or more deserving of acceptance.
senses.usage_conditions: Used comparatively of a statement, testimony, or judgment whose truth or validity is stronger than an alternative.

senses.definition: The Inevitable Reality: the Resurrection and its unavoidable reckoning and recompense.
senses.usage_conditions: The Quranic proper designation الْحَاقَّةُ, explained as the event in which denied realities become manifest and the created beings are encompassed.

senses.definition: Bound, disposed, or fit to do something; worthy or obliged to do it.
senses.usage_conditions: In حَقِيقٌ عَلَى أَنْ, the Quranic expression is read either as expressing obligation or as disposition and earnest fitness to refrain from speaking falsely about God.

senses.definition: Truth, reality, or what accords with fact rather than falsehood.
senses.usage_conditions: Applied to realities, statements, beliefs, revelation, judgments, and events; it can also qualify what is correct, sound, or genuinely established.

senses.definition: A right, due, entitlement, or binding obligation.
senses.usage_conditions: Used for what is owed or incumbent, including a person's due, a duty, or what justice requires. Prepositional expressions such as بِالْحَقِّ and حَقًّا are covered here when the context is due or right conduct rather than bare truth.

senses.definition: The Real or True One, applied to God.
senses.usage_conditions: A divine epithet emphasizing real existence and divinity established according to wisdom and justice.

senses.definition: The Qur'an or revealed truth, used as a designation of the revelation.
senses.usage_conditions: A Quranic designation emphasizing the revelation's status as established truth; this is distinct from the ordinary abstract meaning “truth.”

senses.definition: A decreed or destined thing or event.
senses.usage_conditions: A reported Quranic interpretation of بِالْحَقِّ in 15:8; other interpretations of that expression include revelation or punishment.

other_classical_meanings.definition: Suitableness or correspondence to the requirements of wisdom, justice, rightness, or the circumstances of a case; secure or established existence.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: The broad primary nominal sense from which more particular meanings are derived, including the proper fitting of one thing to another.

other_classical_meanings.definition: Equity, justice, and rightness in conduct.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A specialized nominal meaning distinct from truth as a statement or reality.

other_classical_meanings.definition: The proper or right mode of acting or being.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: Applied to conduct or manner rather than to a right claimed by a person.

other_classical_meanings.definition: Veracity in speech.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A specialized use concerning the truthfulness of a speaker or utterance.

other_classical_meanings.definition: Prudence or sound judgment.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A lexical specialization concerning wise judgment or practical conduct.

other_classical_meanings.definition: A particular right, due, claim, desert, fee, hire, price, duty, or obligation.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: The concrete entitlement or liability belonging to a person or imposed upon one; distinct from the Quranic abstract sense when used in broader legal and social contexts.

other_classical_meanings.definition: A share or portion assigned to someone.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: Used of an allotted portion as in giving each person his due share.

other_classical_meanings.definition: Property or a possession.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A concrete possession rather than an abstract right to possess.

other_classical_meanings.definition: An appurtenance or necessary convenience belonging to a place or household.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: The plural حُقُوق may denote the conveniences or appurtenances of a house.

other_classical_meanings.definition: A necessary or requisite thing.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: Used of something required by the circumstances or by a settled order.

other_classical_meanings.definition: Death.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A reported interpretive use for an expression involving the agony of death; the historical bracketed citation is not treated as a modern verse location.

other_classical_meanings.definition: Islam as the true or rightly established religion.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A specialized application of the noun to the religion of Islam.

other_classical_meanings.definition: An emphatic intensifier meaning extremely or fully, as in “the truly learned.”
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: Restricted to idiomatic nominal constructions such as حَقُّ عَلِيمٍ.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To be proper, fitting, or incumbent for someone to do something.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: Occurs in constructions such as حُقَّ لَكَ and مَا كَانَ يَحُقُّكَ; this is a constructional use distinct from an event becoming due.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To happen, befall, or occur surely.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: An intransitive event use emphasizing that the event occurred without doubt.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To distress, afflict, or cause grief.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: In حَقَّ عَلَيَّ, the construction may mean that another's action or departure is distressing to the speaker.

other_classical_meanings.definition: Of camels, to become fat.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: An animal husbandry use of the intransitive verb.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To establish, verify, ascertain, or judge something true or necessary; to make it firm or due.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: Transitive usage includes certifying a report, confirming a judgment, and making a knot secure.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To tie, fasten, or tighten a knot firmly.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A figurative extension of making something secure.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To render someone adapted, fit, suitable, or worthy to do something.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A transitive causative construction related to حَقِيقٌ بِـ.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To overcome someone in disputing or contending for a right.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: The object is a rival in a claim or legal contention.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To reach someone or something, or to amount to a specified measure.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: Includes reaching a person and the expression for contents reaching or amounting to a stated weight.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To go along the middle or central part of a road, or to strike the central part or socket of the head or shoulder.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A specialized locational and anatomical construction.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To make saturated or firm, including dyeing thoroughly or weaving compactly.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A Form II intensifying use applied to dyeing and textiles.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To be serious or in earnest about an affair.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: The Form II verb is contrasted with joking or frivolity.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To dispute, litigate, or contend with another, each claiming a right or due; sometimes to prevail in that contention.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: The Form III verb is commonly used in reciprocal or third-person dispute constructions.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To act seriously or earnestly with someone in an affair.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A derived construction related to earnest engagement rather than reciprocal litigation.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To speak truth, reveal or manifest a truth or right, or lay claim to a right that becomes due.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: Broader Form IV usage beyond the Quranic sense of establishing truth.

other_classical_meanings.definition: Of a people's cattle, to become fat.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: An intransitive animal husbandry use.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To put an affair into a firm, sound, or good state.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A transitive and figurative Form IV use.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To kill an animal outright with a cast or shot.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A specialized hunting expression.

other_classical_meanings.definition: Of camels, to find and fully pasture upon suitable herbage.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: Used with the name of a type of spring herbage.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To become or prove to be a truth, reality, or fact.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: Also used of information becoming true, correct, or valid in someone's estimation.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To dispute or litigate together, each party demanding his own right or due.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: Reciprocal Form VI usage; it is not normally used of a single person.

other_classical_meanings.definition: Of a knot, to become tied, fastened, or tightened.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A specialized intransitive Form VII construction.

other_classical_meanings.definition: Of a thrust or piercing, to go directly into or through something, sometimes killing it.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: Used of a piercing that reaches the inside or strikes a socket directly.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To hold someone back, retard him, or keep him in straitness until a specified time or event.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A transitive Form VIII construction.

other_classical_meanings.definition: Of a horse, to become lean or light of flesh.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: An animal-condition use.

other_classical_meanings.definition: Of cattle, to become fat, with the fatness reaching its fullest condition.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A specialized intransitive animal husbandry use.

other_classical_meanings.definition: Of a camel, to become fit to be ridden, laden, or used for covering.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: The subject is a camel that has reached the suitable age or condition.

other_classical_meanings.definition: Of a she-camel, to conceive or become pregnant.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A specialized animal-reproduction construction.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To drive or make a riding beast travel at an exhausting pace, beyond its strength.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: The Form R.Q. I noun حَقْحَقَةٌ denotes fatiguing or excessively strenuous journeying, especially by camel.

other_classical_meanings.definition: The breast or mamma of an old woman.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: An anatomical noun distinct from the general meaning of حَقّ.

other_classical_meanings.definition: A tuber of a truffle.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A botanical noun.

other_classical_meanings.definition: A small hollow, socket, or meeting-place of bones, including the shoulder, hip, or a door hinge.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: The term may denote an anatomical socket or the socket of a wooden door.

other_classical_meanings.definition: A spider's web.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A specialized concrete noun.

other_classical_meanings.definition: A camel that has entered its fourth year and is fit to be ridden, laden, or used for covering.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: The female is حِقَّة; the term refers to age and resulting fitness, not merely to an arbitrary young camel.

other_classical_meanings.definition: The established or usual time of a she-camel's pregnancy or expected delivery.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: Used of the period corresponding to the time when she was covered in the preceding year.

other_classical_meanings.definition: The young growth of trees, especially of the mimosa called عُرْفُط.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A plural lexical use by analogy with camels called حِقَاق.

other_classical_meanings.definition: A small receptacle or box, especially one for perfume, ointment, snuff, or similar substances.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A concrete container noun with several material variants.

other_classical_meanings.definition: A woman, by comparison with the receptacle or its shape.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: An explicitly figurative use.

other_classical_meanings.definition: Of a horse, the condition of not sweating and of placing the hind hoof where the fore hoof had been.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: Both are described as faults or distinctive gait conditions.

other_classical_meanings.definition: Persons recently acquainted with or knowledgeable about events and affairs, good and bad.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A plural noun derived from an active-participial branch.

other_classical_meanings.definition: Persons establishing or asserting a claim.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A separate plural use referring to claimants.

other_classical_meanings.definition: Adapted, suited, fit, proper, competent, worthy, or entitled to something.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: The general adjective is construed with بِـ, لِـ, or an implied بِأَنْ construction.

other_classical_meanings.definition: The essence, essential constitution, or true nature of a thing or affair.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: Includes the ultimate constituent of a thing and the reality, gist, or essential facts of a case.

other_classical_meanings.definition: A word or expression used in its proper, original, or conventionally established literal sense, as opposed to a metaphorical sense.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A technical linguistic and legal-theoretical use; حَقِيقَةٌ عُرْفِيَّةٌ is a conventionalized proper use.

other_classical_meanings.definition: That which, or those whom, one is obliged to defend or protect.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: In حَامِي الْحَقِيقَةِ, the noun may include household members, dependants, neighbors, or property requiring protection.

other_classical_meanings.definition: A banner or standard.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: An explicitly extended use included under the protected emblem or people.

other_classical_meanings.definition: That which is sacred or inviolable and must be respected or honored.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A figurative extension of what one is bound to protect.

other_classical_meanings.definition: A hurried, laborious night journey to water.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A fixed collocation describing strenuous or rapid travel.

other_classical_meanings.definition: True, complete, or perfect, especially perfect in manliness or courage.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: Used in emphatic descriptive constructions such as a man perfect in manliness or courage.

other_classical_meanings.definition: Vehement or severe hunger.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: Occurs in the collocation حَاقُّ الجُوعِ, with an alternative analysis relating it to hunger besetting someone.

other_classical_meanings.definition: The middle or central part of the head, nape, eye, road, or winter.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A locational noun for the central point or middle of a specified thing or period.

other_classical_meanings.definition: A state of straitness caused by something.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: Used in فِي حَاقٍّ مِنْ كَذَا.

other_classical_meanings.definition: A severe calamity, affliction, or momentous event whose occurrence is fixed or established.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: The general calamity sense is distinct from the Quranic proper designation of the Resurrection.

other_classical_meanings.definition: Of a horse, one that does not sweat.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A specialized animal descriptor.

other_classical_meanings.definition: Of a horse, one that places its hind hoof where its fore hoof had been.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A gait descriptor, also called حَقَق.

other_classical_meanings.definition: Speaking truth, revealing or manifesting a truth or right, or claiming a right that is due.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: An active participle describing one who establishes or asserts the true or due claim.

other_classical_meanings.definition: Of speech or language, sound, compact, and orderly.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A passive-participial adjective describing well-formed or firmly articulated speech.

other_classical_meanings.definition: Of a garment, firmly or compactly woven and figured.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A textile use of the passive participle.

other_classical_meanings.definition: A critical judge or verifier in matters of literature.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A later technical use of the active participle.

other_classical_meanings.definition: Cattle that have not produced or been milked in the preceding year, or whose first milkings are colostrum.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A specialized livestock noun.

other_classical_meanings.definition: A thrust or piercing that proceeds without swerving from the right direction.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A fixed descriptive expression for a direct, accurately placed thrust.

cautions: حَقِيقٌ عَلَى in 7:105 has reported readings and interpretations of obligation versus disposition or fitness; the form is therefore defined broadly enough to preserve both.
The interpretation of بِالْحَقِّ in 15:8 as a decreed or destined event is explicitly reported but is not the only interpretation.
The historical Lane notation for one reported death interpretation is not converted into a modern verse location.
Some Classical branches belong to homonymous or derived headwords and are kept separate rather than being folded into the Quranic meanings of حَقّ.
